title: Apply for or Renew a Ghanaian Passport
description: The ordered journey to obtain or renew a Ghanaian biometric passport—from Ghana Card identity verification and birth certification to online application submission and biometric capture at a Passport Application Centre (PAC).

steps.title: Verify National Identity (Ghana Card) with NIA
steps.why: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs mandates the National Biometric Ghana Card as the primary prerequisite to apply for or renew a Ghanaian passport.
steps.do_this_when: Before purchasing or initiating an online passport application.

options.label: National Identification Authority Forms Portal
options.notes: Verify or download Ghana Card application and personal data update forms.

options.label: Ghana Card Data Update / Correction Service
options.notes: Use if personal details or spelling differ from your birth certificate.

steps.title: Obtain or Verify Biometric Birth Certificate with BDR
steps.why: A verifiable biometric birth certificate from the Births and Deaths Registry is mandatory proof of citizenship for first-time applicants.
steps.do_this_when: Before filling the online passport form if you do not already possess a biometric birth certificate.

options.label: Births and Deaths Registry Online Registration
options.notes: Official portal for birth registration and certified birth certificate issuance.

steps.title: Complete Online Passport Application via MFARI
steps.why: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration requires all passport processing, voucher payments, and center selections to be submitted through the official portal.
steps.do_this_when: Once you have your Ghana Card and birth certificate details ready.

options.label: Ghana Passport Application Portal (Standard Service)
options.notes: Official step-by-step instructions and online account sign-up.

options.label: Manual Passport Application Form (PAC Submission)
options.notes: Direct downloadable PDF form for physical submission reference.

steps.title: Attend Biometric Capture at Passport Application Centre (PAC)
steps.why: Biometric photographs and fingerprint capture must be recorded in person at your chosen Passport Application Centre (e.g., Accra, Kumasi, Tamale).
steps.do_this_when: On your scheduled appointment date following online form submission.

options.label: Passport Application Portal Dashboard
options.notes: Print your appointment slip and application confirmation.

steps.title: Document Legalisation & Authentication for Foreign Use
steps.why: If travelling abroad for study, employment, or relocation, foreign embassies require Ghanaian certificates and police records to be authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
steps.do_this_when: After obtaining your passport or when preparing travel dossiers.

options.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Document Legalisation Desk
options.notes: Legalisation division portal for document authentication in Accra.
